genomes.name: Calm Trend, Fast Exit
genomes.thesis: The core entries (above the 50-day with volatility under 25%, a 1.35-sigma dip above the 200-day, a close back over the 50-day) with a faster exit: it sells the first close under the 20-day mean that is not oversold instead of waiting for the 50-day, or when volatility passes 50%; 4.2% stop, 7% target, 5% trailing stop, 13 sessions, two-session wait.
genomes.rationale: Written by Claude in round three to test a faster trend exit; scored exactly as written.
